nodes.s: Context engine: persistent knowledge graph in .scope/files/ with ranked search, upstream/downstream flow, git push state, GitHub issues, interactive viewer.
Scope fires BEFORE any Grep/Glob/Read exploration. Ritual: read .scope/MAP.md, git-overlay, issues if relevant, then query the task nouns. MSNC's Tuner routes here; its gate enforces impact.
Climb only as far as needed: MAP.md 600tk orientation, query 40tk/hit, context 700tk full picture, neighbors 1200tk, then ranged Read at anchor lines. Never cat the jsonl stores.
Mandatory before ending a turn: scan changed files, set-summary improved understanding (mechanism not vibes, 200 chars), add relates/implements edges, record decisions, resync issues.
Project context lives in the graph, work items in GitHub issues. No scratch NOTES.md/TODO.md/context.md files - they fragment context, go stale silently and nothing indexes them.
If two queries miss, fall back to Grep then write the finding back as a node or edge. A miss is a defect in the graph, not a reason to abandon it; next session should hit.
Creates the .scope/files/ tree and config.json, and appends overlays/ and view/ to .gitignore.
Bootstrap an existing repo: init then scan (under a second for hundreds of files), then git-overlay, issues, graph-html. Both init steps are idempotent and append rather than replace.
A fresh scan has structure but no insight. Expand the highest fan-in files, replace their generated summaries with real ones, write MAP.md Orientation, add relates edges the scanner cannot see.
Incremental index: hashes files (LF-normalized), extracts imports/exports/anchors per language, builds file/mod/entry nodes and scan-owned edges, regenerates MAP.md sections. --full ignores hashes.
Rebuilds index/terms.tsv, the inverted term-to-node index. Runs automatically after scan, issues and note; run manually to repair a corrupt or conflicted index.
Ranked retrieval, ~40 tokens per hit. Scores idf x field weight x coverage x type boost x importance, penalizes stale. Flags --type --k --budget. Hits carry flow markers in:N out:N d:N.
The standard unit of understanding: one card showing what reaches this file, what breaks if it changes, what it depends on, plus tests, docs, siblings, issues, git state, staleness.
BFS adjacency grouped by edge type, --depth 1-3, --dir in/out/both, --type filter. Use when tracing an unusual relation that context does not surface.
Bidirectional BFS showing how two nodes connect, up to 6 hops, undirected over all edge types. Answers 'is A related to B and how'.
Symbol-level deep dive on one file: creates sym nodes with line anchors for ranged reads, exports edges, and heuristic intra-file calls edges. Re-runs automatically on later scans.
Per-file push state (conflicted > modified > staged > unpushed > pushed) via porcelain -z and three-dot diff. Auto-refreshed by the session hook and every scan. No upstream: only dirty files marked.
Syncs GitHub issues into the graph as nodes with blocks/part-of/closes/mentions edges, caches database ids, computes the frontier. Falls back to body conventions if the API is unavailable.
Creates a GitHub dependency. Two-step: resolve the blocker's numeric DATABASE id via gh api issues/N --jq .id, then POST blocked_by with -F issue_id. Not the issue number, not node_id.
Detects drift: content hash changed since the summary was written marks a node stale, missing files mark it dead. Reports which agent-written summaries most need re-blessing.
Removes dead nodes, orphan edges and duplicates, and flags over-budget summaries for rewrite. Closed issues are kept as knowledge; --dry-run previews. This is how the store is trimmed.
Store size by layer in estimated tokens, node and edge counts by type, top fan-in nodes, 'enrich next' (most-imported files still lacking an agent summary), breached budgets.
Generates the self-contained interactive viewer at .scope/files/view/scope.html with all data embedded and zero network requests. Refresh overlays first so push state and issues are current.
Write-back helpers: note add creates concept/note nodes, note set-summary re-blesses a node as agent-authored and clears stale, note edge records a learned relation. Enforces the 200-char limit.
JSONL keys id t k s g h a st w by ts. Types file mod sym concept adr issue skill note entry. Summary hard max 200 chars. by:agent guards a summary so scan marks it stale but never overwrites.
imports exports part-of tested-by documents calls blocks closes mentions relates implements. Scan owns structural types, issues owns GitHub types, relates/implements are agent-only.
Layered DAG left-to-right from entrypoints over reversed imports: click-to-light upstream/downstream ribbons, numbered sequence, impact mode, work-in-flight preset showing where open work sits.
Fill by node type, issues are hexagons green open grey closed. Ring shows git state: none pushed, amber unpushed, blue staged, orange modified, grey dashed untracked, red conflicted. Hatch is stale.
MAP.md 600 tokens, query output 1500, context 900, node summary 200 chars hard, whole store 50k soft. Breaches are reported by stats; the fix is denser summaries or prune, not a bigger limit.
A scan with no file changes produces a byte-identical store: sorted nodes and edges, fixed key order, LF-normalized hashing. Merge conflicts resolve by keeping both sides then scan && index.
